subject: esl

courseOpsExtract.lessonTypeReason: First day of ESLDO with classroom expectations, instruction on root words/prefixes/suffixes, warm-up, video, in-class forum activity, and homework assignment. Mix of instruction and practice.

opsItems.title: First 5 minutes: log in, turn on camera, display English name
opsItems.studentAction: Log in to class, turn on camera, change name to English letters within first 5 minutes each day
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'In the first 5 minutes, log in, turn on your camera, change your name to English letters.'

opsItems.title: KWL Chart (Questions 1 and 2 only)
opsItems.studentAction: Complete the KWL chart answering 'What do you know about essay writing?' and 'What do you want to know about essay writing?'
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'Please make sure you do this... send it to me by tomorrow.'

opsItems.title: Discussion Forum: Root Words, Prefixes, Suffixes
opsItems.studentAction: Answer the pre-learning activity questions in the Schoology discussion forum
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'You'll answer your questions here in the forum... This is very important for participation.'

opsItems.title: Homework: Two worksheets on prefixes, root words, suffixes
opsItems.studentAction: Complete the two homework documents from Schoology
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'Once you're finished in the forum, go to the homework section and complete these two documents.' No due date given.

opsItems.title: Review plagiarism program
opsItems.studentAction: Read the plagiarism policy in Schoology (after class)
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'Don't forget to review or take a look at the plagiarism program... you can do that after class.'

opsItems.title: Prepare cameras and names for tomorrow
opsItems.studentAction: Ensure camera is working and name is set in English letters for next class
opsItems.appliesTo: students who had issues (Andy, Shellay, Tseng)
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'Tomorrow, please try your best to join on time, turn on camera, change name to English letters.'

uncertainItems.rawText: Homework due date not specified for two worksheets
uncertainItems.reason: Teacher mentioned 'homework' but did not give a due date; it may be due next class or could be ongoing.

title: ESLDO Exit Card Readiness Package
problemAnchor: 本节课主要检查学生是否知道考试、作业、提交、材料或平台等下一步要求。

abt.and: 你已经收到本节课的重要安排。
abt.but: 如果错过材料、平台、截止日期或考试要求，学习表现会被非知识因素影响。
abt.therefore: 系统先确认你是否知道下一步行动；不通过时触发提醒或人工确认。

objective: 学生能确认本节课后的关键行动、材料、平台、截止日期或考试要求。

learningGoals.statement: Students will be able to recall and explain the first 5 minutes classroom routine, assignment deadlines, and platform used for activities.
Students will be able to recall and explain the first 5 minutes classroom routine, assignment deadlines, and platform used for activities.

diagnosisRules.condition: student cannot identify the correct first 5 minutes actions
diagnosisRules.systemAction: send reminder to student and ask teacher to confirm understanding
diagnosisRules.studentMessage: Please review the classroom expectations: log in, turn on camera, and change your name to English letters within the first 5 minutes.

diagnosisRules.condition: student does not know KWL chart deadline
diagnosisRules.systemAction: send reminder about the due date
diagnosisRules.studentMessage: Don't forget: the KWL chart (questions 1 and 2) is due tomorrow, July 7, on Schoology.

diagnosisRules.condition: student does not know next steps for camera/name issues
diagnosisRules.systemAction: ask teacher to follow up with student
diagnosisRules.studentMessage: If your camera or name display had issues today, please fix them before next class. Join on time with camera on and English name.

questions.stem: What should you do in the first 5 minutes of every ESLDO class?
questions.successCriteria: Student selects the option that includes all three actions: log in, turn on camera, change name to English letters.
questions.ossdExpectation: ESLDO: Demonstrate understanding of classroom expectations
questions.stemIntent: To check if students remember the specific routine described by the teacher.
questions.commonMisconception: Students may think only one action is needed (e.g., just logging in) or may forget to change their name.

options.text: Log in, turn on your camera, and change your name to English letters.
Log in and turn on your camera only.
options.feedbackWrong: You also need to change your name to English letters so the teacher can read it.

options.text: Log in and change your name, but camera is optional.
options.feedbackWrong: Camera must be turned on as part of the routine.

options.text: Just log in; other things can be done later.
options.feedbackWrong: All three steps should be completed within the first 5 minutes.

questions.stem: When is the KWL chart (questions 1 and 2 only) due?
questions.stemIntent: To verify students know the deadline for the first assignment.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might think it is due today or later in the week.

options.feedbackWrong: The teacher said to send it by tomorrow, July 7.

questions.stem: Where should you complete the pre-learning activity about root words, prefixes, and suffixes?
questions.successCriteria: Student selects 'In the Schoology discussion forum'.
questions.ossdExpectation: ESLDO: Use online platforms for learning activities
questions.stemIntent: To check that students know which platform to use for in-class forum work.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might think it is on Feishu/Lark or a different platform.

options.feedbackWrong: The activity is in Schoology, not Feishu.

options.text: On a worksheet emailed to you
options.feedbackWrong: The activity is in the Schoology discussion forum.
The video is for learning; the activity is posted in the discussion forum.

questions.stem: If your camera was not working or your name was not showing today, what should you do before next class?
questions.successCriteria: Student selects 'Fix the camera and set your name to English letters so everything is ready for tomorrow.'
questions.ossdExpectation: ESLDO: Demonstrate responsibility for technical readiness
questions.stemIntent: To ensure students understand the expectation to resolve technical issues by next class.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might think it's okay to wait longer or ignore the issue.

options.text: Fix the camera and set your name to English letters so everything is ready for tomorrow.
It's not important; the teacher will understand.
options.feedbackWrong: The teacher emphasized that cameras and English names are required for participation.

options.text: Wait for the teacher to contact you about it.
options.feedbackWrong: The expectation is that you prepare on your own before next class.

options.text: Only fix the camera; name can stay as numbers.
options.feedbackWrong: Both camera and English name are needed.
